title: Exponential UI core (lite)
description: Exponential UI core-lite catalog v1 (A2UI 1.0): 72 components (the lite subset of the core), the A2UI basic catalog's 14 functions plus 41 core functions, the Box style whitelist and the token names. Generated by packages/exponential-ui/scripts/generate.ts from catalog/core.catalog.json — do not edit.
instructions:
Exponential UI core: shadcn-named components for app-shaped surfaces.

## Catalog rules

1. Components are flat: `{id, component, ...props}`. Exactly one has the id `root`. Ids are identifiers (letters, digits, `_`). `children` are ids (`["a", "b"]`), never inline components, or `{componentId, path, key?}`: one `componentId` per item of the array at `path` (`key` = the item field naming it). `slots` = `{name: id}`.
2. A dynamic prop takes a literal, a binding `{"@path": "/json/pointer"}` or a call `{"@call": "name", "args": {…}}`. Keep data in the data model and bind to it; a path without a leading `/` reads the current item.
3. `on: {<event>: action}`: an action is `{event: {name, context?, userMessage?}}` (sent to the agent) and/or `{functionCall: {"@call", args}}` (runs on the renderer: a catalog function, `set`, or a host function such as `app_toast`).
4. `visible: false` (or a binding) removes a component and its space. Inputs take `checks: [{condition, message?}]`; a condition is a binding or a call (`required`, `regex`, `length`, `numeric`, `email`).
5. Lay out with Page, Stack, Grid, Card, SplitView, Sidebar and List. A row of controls is a Toolbar, fields side by side a FieldGroup, the Cancel/submit row FormActions; Box + `style` only for the rest. Wrap fields in Form.
6. Prefer catalog components over Markdown, labels and tones over colours. A colour is a `$color.*` token, never `#hex`. Leave built-in copy (Cancel, Search…) unset: it is localized.
7. One default Button per screen (the submit or main action); the rest outline, secondary or ghost.

Box.description: A styled container laid out by the whitelisted style object; what every macro expands into. `on.hover` fires when the pointer enters it.

style.description: Layout and visual properties from the Box whitelist (flex, grid, sizes, spacing, colours).

pressable.description: Makes the box a press target that fires `press`.

Stack.description: A flex container that lays its children out in one direction with a gap.

direction.description: A row or a column (`{base: "vertical", md: "horizontal"}`).

align.description: Unset: `center` in a row, `stretch` in a column.

wrap.description: Lets children wrap onto new lines.

style.description: Extra Box styles merged over the stack's own.

Grid.description: An equal-column grid for cards and tiles.

style.description: Extra Box styles merged over the grid's own.

Card.description: A bordered card with an optional title and description, for grouped content, not page headers.

description.description: A muted line under the heading.

padded.description: Pads the body; off for edge-to-edge rows.

style.description: Extra Box styles merged over the card's own.

pressable.description: A press target firing `press` (an `on.press` implies it).

Window.description: A window frame: a chrome bar with three dots and an optional caption over one child that fills the body.

title.description: The centred caption in the chrome bar.

style.description: Extra Box styles merged over the window's own.

orientation.description: A horizontal rule or a vertical bar.

List.description: A windowed scrolling list for anything longer than a screen; children may come from a data template.

sectionBy.description: Groups consecutive items by this field; slot `section` = each header ({value, count}).

style.description: Extra Box styles for the list frame.

Resizable.description: Panels split by draggable handles; each child is one panel.

handle.description: Draws a grip on each handle.

style.description: Extra Box styles for the group box (give it a height).

ScrollArea.description: A scrolling region of bounded height or width.

maxHeight.description: Px it scrolls within; omit to fill the parent.

style.description: Extra Box styles merged over the region's own.

Sidebar.description: A shell: a nav column (`sidebar` slot) beside the children, hidden narrow or collapsed.

collapsed.description: Hides the column; bind it to a toggle.

SplitView.description: List (`list` slot) + detail (children); phones show one at a time, the detail with a back button.

open.description: On phones, the detail shows instead of the list; bind it to the open item.

width.description: The list column width in px.

AppBar.description: A top bar: title, optional subtitle and back button, `leading`/`trailing` slots.

subtitle.description: A muted line under the title.

back.description: Shows a back button that fires `back`.

Page.description: A screen: an AppBar row (back, title, trailing actions) over a padded scrolling body.

subtitle.description: A muted line under the title.

back.description: Shows a back button that fires `back`.

padded.description: Pads the body; off for edge-to-edge lists.

Toolbar.description: Controls in one row, bottoms aligned, wrapping on phones; `trailing` = the end action.

Section.description: A band header over hairline-divided rows: title, caption, count and glyph, foldable, tinted; no title = just the rows.

title.description: The band's label; omit it for a bare run of rows.

count.description: A count after the title; off unless given.

icon.description: A glyph before the title (the `leading` slot replaces it).

collapsible.description: The header folds the rows (chevron, press).

open.description: Whether the rows show; bind it.

tree.description: The rows form a tree: each `Row.depth` indents and draws its guides.

loading.description: A refetch is running: a small spinner before the count. The first load is a Skeleton instead.

style.description: Extra Box styles for the frame.

Group.description: A form-field container: a rounded group of rows with an optional title and footnote.

footer.description: A muted note under the group.

Text.description: A run of text in one of the type styles; prefer dedicated components over inline markdown.

lines.description: Truncates to this many lines with an ellipsis.

tone.description: A colour tone instead of the default foreground.

shimmer.description: Animates a highlight across the text while work runs.

style.description: Extra Box styles for the text box.

Heading.description: A section or page heading at one of four levels.

level.description: h1 is the page title, h4 the smallest.

profile.description: `inline` = a run of text (no outer block gap, paragraphs in the Text type of `variant`), `document` = full prose.

variant.description: The paragraph type of the inline profile.

lines.description: Truncates the rendered body to this many lines with an ellipsis.

style.description: Extra Box styles for the markdown box.

CodeBlock.description: Source code in a mono block: syntax colouring, optional line numbers, a copy button.

wrap.description: Wraps long lines instead of scrolling sideways.

maxLines.description: Lines shown before the block scrolls.

Kbd.description: A keyboard shortcut drawn as a key cap.

for.description: The id of the control it labels.

Icon.description: One icon from the shared Lucide registry, by name.

name.description: The icon name (an icons.json concept or Lucide name).

tone.description: A colour tone instead of the current text colour.

label.description: An accessibility label when the icon stands alone.

seed.description: Hashes the fallback hue; defaults to the name.

Tabs.description: Tab navigation; the child at index i is the panel of tab i.

value.description: The active tab's value; bind it for two-way state.

fill.description: Stretches the headers across the width.

Segmented.description: ONE row or column of segments: a pill track, toggles, joined outline buttons, a bottom bar or a rail.

variant.description: Pill track, bare toggles, joined outline buttons, or a full-width icon `bar`.

Collapsible.description: One disclosure section with a title row that shows or hides its children.

open.description: Whether the body shows; bind it.

count.description: A count shown in the header.

status.description: running shimmers, error tints, pending dims, done ticks, skipped strikes.

open.description: Whether the children show; bind it.

Plan.description: A plan card: steps to approve, then progress and Stop.

Breadcrumb.description: The path to the current page; every item but the last is a link firing `select`.

Outline.description: Anchor rows under a caption, one active; press fires `select {id}`.

removable.description: Shows a remove control that fires `remove`.

pressable.description: Makes it a press target that fires `press`.

The field's key in the submitted data.

pressable.description: A press target firing `press` (`on.press` or `href` imply it).

href.description: The URL a press opens; implies `pressable`.

TreeGuides.description: The tree gutter a nested Row draws (filled by the core); never authored directly.

Motion.description: A vector animation (Lottie-compatible) drawn identically everywhere: loaders, success states, illustrated empty states, small explainers.

layers.description: The animation, top layer first, in the composition's px (origin top-left). Layer: {type: shape|solid|null|precomp|text, id?, parent?: id, in?/out? ms, transform?: {anchor, position [x,y], scale [100,100] %, rotation deg clockwise, opacity 0–100}, shapes: […], matte?: {source: id, mode: alpha|luma}, masks?: [{path, mode: add|subtract|intersect}]}. Shapes draw top first; a style paints every shape before it in its group: rect {position (centre), size, radius}, ellipse {position, size}, star|polygon {points, outerRadius, innerRadius}, path {d: SVG path data}; fill {color}, stroke {color, width, cap, join, dash: [len, gap]}, gradient-fill {kind: linear|radial, start, end, stops: [[0, colour], [1, colour]]}; trim {start, end, offset} (percent, draw-on lines), repeater {copies, transform}, round-corners {radius}; group {shapes, transform}. Colours: $color.* tokens (follow light/dark), #hex, or {light, dark}. Animate any value: {keys: [{t: ms, v: value, ease: linear|ease-in|ease-out|ease-in-out|hold|[x1,y1,x2,y2]}, …]}; tokens cannot animate. Keep it small; loops end on their first pose. No expressions.

lottie.description: Lottie JSON instead of layers (no expressions).

src.description: An attached .json or .lottie instead of layers.

autoplay.description: Plays when visible; false shows the poster.

loop.description: Repeats; false plays once and holds.

direction.description: Forward, reverse, or back and forth.

poster.description: The still frame (ms) for reduced motion and before play.

inputs.description: State-machine inputs {name: value}; bind to drive states from data.

label.description: What it shows, for screen readers.

style.description: Extra Box styles for the box.

shapes.description: Motion's shapes, no keys, + text {text, position, size, weight, align start|center|end, baseline top|middle|alphabetic, font sans|mono, color} on top, always upright.

label.description: What it shows, for screen readers.

pointer.description: press/move/leave get {x, y} in drawing units.

style.description: Extra Box styles for the box.

source.description: Where a records `by` binding lands (reads `month` or `week`).

labelField.description: The row field a bar shows.

Timeline.description: Records over time: rows of chart-coloured bars across week, month or quarter columns.

labelField.description: The row field a bar shows.

showCount.description: Each row's count under its label.

RecordForm.description: A form over one record kind: a field per schema field with its checks; submit saves the record.

recordId.description: The record to update; none = a new record.

readOnly.description: Shows the fields inert, no submit.

path.description: The draft's data path (default /recordForm/<id>); seed it to edit.

required.description: Checks that the value is not null, undefined, or empty.

regex.description: Checks that the value matches a regular expression string.

pattern.description: The regular expression to search for in the value. Uses the A2UI regex dialect: a portable subset of ECMAScript pattern syntax in Unicode mode with no flags. Matching is case-sensitive, '.' excludes line terminators, and '^' and '$' match only at the ends of the value. Backreferences, lookbehind, named groups and '\p{...}' are not allowed. Patterns longer than 256 code points or that could backtrack catastrophically are rejected.

email.description: Checks that the value is a valid email address.

formatString.description: Performs string interpolation of data model values and other functions in the catalog functions list and returns the resulting string. The value string can contain interpolated expressions in the `${expression}` format. Supported expression types include: JSON Pointer paths to the data model (e.g., `${/absolute/path}` or `${relative/path}`), and renderer-side function calls (e.g., `${now()}`). Function arguments must be named (e.g., `${formatDate(value:${/currentDate}, format:'MM-dd')}`). To include a literal `${` sequence, escape it as `\${`.

formatNumber.description: Formats a number with the specified grouping and decimal precision.

decimals.description: Optional. The number of decimal places to show. Defaults to 0 or 2 depending on locale.

grouping.description: Optional. If true, uses locale-specific grouping separators (e.g. '1,000'). If false, returns raw digits (e.g. '1000'). Defaults to true.

formatCurrency.description: Formats a number as a currency string.

decimals.description: Optional. The number of decimal places to show. Defaults to 0 or 2 depending on locale.

grouping.description: Optional. If true, uses locale-specific grouping separators (e.g. '1,000'). If false, returns raw digits (e.g. '1000'). Defaults to true.

formatDate.description: Formats a timestamp into a string using a pattern.

format.description:
A Unicode TR35 date pattern string.

Token Reference:
- Year: 'yy' (26), 'yyyy' (2026)
- Month: 'M' (1), 'MM' (01), 'MMM' (Jan), 'MMMM' (January)
- Day: 'd' (1), 'dd' (01), 'E' (Tue), 'EEEE' (Tuesday)
- Hour (12h): 'h' (1-12), 'hh' (01-12) - requires 'a' for AM/PM
- Hour (24h): 'H' (0-23), 'HH' (00-23) - Military Time
- Minute: 'mm' (00-59)
- Second: 'ss' (00-59)
- Period: 'a' (AM/PM)

Examples:
- 'MMM dd, yyyy' -> 'Jan 16, 2026'
- 'HH:mm' -> '14:30' (Military)
- 'h:mm a' -> '2:30 PM'
- 'EEEE, d MMMM' -> 'Friday, 16 January'

pluralize.description: Returns a localized string based on the Common Locale Data Repository (CLDR) plural category of the count (zero, one, two, few, many, other). Requires an 'other' fallback. For English, just use 'one' and 'other'.

value.description: The numeric value used to determine the plural category.

two.description: String for the 'two' category (used in Arabic, Welsh, etc.).

few.description: String for the 'few' category (e.g., small groups in Slavic languages).

many.description: String for the 'many' category (e.g., large groups in various languages).

other.description: The default/fallback string (used for general plural cases).

openUrl.description: Opens the specified URL in a browser or handler (requires user activation). This function has no return value.

and.description: Performs a logical AND operation on a list of boolean values.

values.description: The list of boolean values to evaluate.

or.description: Performs a logical OR operation on a list of boolean values.

values.description: The list of boolean values to evaluate.

not.description: Performs a logical NOT operation on a boolean value.

percent.description: The share of max as "N%", clamped to 0..100, two decimals; 0% when max is not positive.

eq.description: Strict equality of two values, except that a number equals a string spelling it (5 and "5"); nothing else coerces.

clamp.description: value as a number held inside [min, max]; a missing bound does not clamp; min wins when max < min.

fallback.description: value unless it is missing (undefined or null), else default; a template's `{x|default}` over a bound x.

concat.description: The values joined into one string (undefined and null as empty).

text.description: The value as a string; no value when it is missing.

map.description: cases[String(value)] when that case exists, else default.

len.description: An array's or a string's length, else 0.

fill.description: template with its {name} placeholders filled from params (unknown ones stay); a `$string.<id>` template resolves through the surface's string table first.

set.description: Action only: writes value into the data model at path (a JSON pointer, relative to the node's data scope like a binding).

formatPercent.description: A ratio as a locale percent through the surface Formatter (0.256 → 26%); decimals = fixed fraction digits.

formatRelativeTime.description: A date (yyyy-mm-dd, ISO date-time or epoch ms) relative to now (epoch ms or a date; default the clock) through the surface Formatter: 3 minutes ago, yesterday, in 2 hours.

filter.description: The items that match, in order: every `where` field equals its value (an empty value matches all) and `query` is a case-insensitive substring of one of `fields` (default every text field); bind a List or Table to it.

bind.description: Action only (VAPP-122): re-follows path from source with params appended as its query (sourceWithParams); the package's sources allowlist applies and the earlier subscription at that path is cancelled.

mul.description: a * b; numbers only (else no value).

div.description: a / b; no value when b is 0.

mod.description: a % b (sign of a); no value when b is 0.

round.description: Half away from zero, to digits (0..10, default 0).

today.description: Today (YYYY-MM-DD) in the team time zone.

dateTime.description: A day (YYYY-MM-DD) at a wall-clock time (HH:MM; none = midnight) in the team time zone, as an ISO instant.

dateAdd.description: date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO instant) plus n whole units (second minute hour day week month quarter year; a day keeps the local time; month ends clamp).

dateDiff.description: Whole units from a to b (b - a, truncated).

startOf.description: The first day (or instant) of date's day, week (Monday), month, quarter or year.

endOf.description: The last day (or instant) of that unit.

orElse.description: The value, or default when it is missing (null): narrows an optional value.

expr.description: Evaluates a CEL expression string (docs/package-format.md Expressions) over vars (name → value or binding): "round(entries.sum / 60, 1)"; default is shown when it fails (required in a package).

Style.description: The Box style whitelist (VAPP-4, round 1): layout + visual keys, numbers in px, token references $<group>.<name>; conditions nest one level: @media (min-/max-width|height, orientation, hover, prefers-reduced-motion; px or $breakpoint.<name>) in source order, then the states :hover, :focus-visible, :pressed.

Tokens.description: The token NAMES a theme must define, by group (values come from the theme).

ChildList.description: Child component ids, or one template component per item of the array at `path`; `key` (ours) = a pointer relative to each item that identifies it, so reordering keeps the item's component state (the index when absent).

EuiAction.description: A core action: an agent event, a renderer function, or both (round 1: the function args and the event context are evaluated first, then the function runs, then the event is dispatched). `functionCall` may name a catalog function or a host function (`app_toast`; the host registers it and its policy gates it).

value.description: The value reported when the section is open.

count.description: A count shown in the header.

field.description: With `rows`: the row field each value reads.

tone.description: The series' colour tone; charts default to the chart hues in order.

description.description: A muted line under the name.

type.description: How cells render: text, a locale number/currency/percent, a date, a relative time, a tick, a badge, or the named slot's component once per row.

slot.description: For `type: slot`: the Table slot whose component renders each cell with the row as its data scope.

width.description: A fixed width in px; otherwise columns share the width, never under 120 (a wider table scrolls).

sortable.description: Lets the header toggle the sort.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of a currency column (USD).

decimals.description: Fixed fraction digits of a number, currency or percent column.

truncate.description: One line with an ellipsis; cells wrap otherwise.

panel.description: One Resizable panel's limits, percent of the group.

collapsible.description: Drags to 0 below half its min; Enter on the handle toggles.

url.description: Where it was stored, for a preview link.

dateMark.description: An event dot on a day.

icon.description: The glyph (default: a folder or a file).

children.description: Child nodes; makes it a branch.

hasChildren.description: A branch whose children load on open (`load`).
